capabilities: Align each lyric line to a YouTube video's audio locally
Jump to a line by clicking it
Highlight and keep the current line centred during playback
Loop a single line or a whole section
Keep one player tab per song with playback position and loop state
disambiguation: Not a karaoke or audio-recording tool; it aligns lyric notes you supply to a YouTube video and never fetches lyrics.
extras: Desktop only and macOS Apple Silicon only for now; first use downloads Python packages and a ~450 MB Whisper model, and audio, model and alignment results are cached in ~/.cache/obsidian-sing-along/ outside the vault. The UI is in Traditional Chinese and users must supply their own lyrics.
problem: Practising a song from a lyric note means manually seeking the video for every line, because notes carry no timestamps tied to the audio.

relations.evidence: pairs a note of three-line lyrics (romaji, Japanese, translation) with a YouTube video

summary: Player that aligns a three-line Japanese lyric note to a YouTube video on the local machine, with click-to-jump, follow-along and looping.
